Name: Tile Kitchen and Dining Set
Author: orangeblossom7
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][size=4]Tile Kitchen & Dining Set[/size]
[size=2]by orangeblossom[/size][/font][/center][font=Georgia]
This is a kitchen and dining set I made to match Too Many Swatches II. 
[/font][font=Georgia]
[center]--------[/center]
[u]furniture list:[/u]
- coffee table (modular dining table; 9 swatches) 
- luxury bookcase (pantry; 9 swatches)
- red diner chair (1 swatch)
- winter dining table (island; 1 swatch)
- 'Sun #44' (pantry top - mini fridge ver.)
- mini fridge (pantry L and R - mini fridge ver.; 9 swatches)
- birch end table (modular side counters; ; 4 versions, 9 swatches)

[u]kitchen counter swatches:[/u]
- green
- yellow
- muted green
- muted brown
- muted yellow
- pink
- blue
- black
- white

[u]kitchen appliances swatches:[/u]
- pink
- silver
- black
- white
- blue
- green
- lavender
- yellow

[i]NOTES:[/i][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][s]there is only one swatch ﻿(≧ω≦) for now. [size=1]hahaha! [/size][/s][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Now available in all swatches, except for the red diner chair.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]I added modular side counters because I noticed that the built-in ones disappear after availing the dining room upgrade from Robin.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=2]Only tested in the vanilla farmhouse.[/size][/font]﻿
[/list][font=Georgia][size=2][i]
[b][u]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/u][/b]
[/i][/size][list][*]Use [u]GMCM[/u] to change the colors of the kitchen counters and appliances.
[*]Don't forget to [u]match the colors of 'KitchenAppliances' and 'KitchenApplianceOpenFridge[/u]' (if you don't want to hurt your eyes hahaha) using GMCM.﻿
[*]I recommend [u]manual downloading[/u] and installing because I heard Vortex messes up configs.
[/list][/font]
